Name: Reforged - Buffs Edition
Author: BitByDit
Description:
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/xvgV6Tp.gif[/img]

[size=5][center]DESCRIPTION[/center][/size][/b][b][center][size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/center][/b][size=3]﻿Breathes new life into Stardew Valley's buff icons with a [b]complete visual refresh[/b]—every farming bonus, speed boost, luck charm, and negative effects has been [b]carefully redrawn[/b] to feel crisp and more cohesive, all [b]while preserving the classic charm[/b]. Whether you're sipping coffee or getting hit by the slime, [b][color=#e69138]Reforged -[/color] [color=#e69138]Buffs Edition[/color][/b] ensures your buff icons looks [b]fresh[/b], [b]clean[/b], and [/size][b][size=3]faithful![/size][/b]
[b]
[/b][center][b]
[size=5]FEATURES[/size][size=3] 
[/size][size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/b][/center][size=3][b]Polished[/b] and redrawn, yet [b]completely faithful[/b]. These buff icons keep that nostalgic Pelican Town feel, now with a little [b]extra love in every pixel![/b][/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/MbFFneo.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DlAGQRk.gif[/img][/center][size=3][center]All the [b]good stuff[/b]—farming boosts, speed ups, you name it—[b]got a fresh coat of paint[/b]. They're [b]cleaner[/b] and [b]brighter![/b][/center][/size][center][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/XeJU8ZE.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/H8i8Y1c.gif[/img][/center][size=3][center]Wanna know when you're screwed? Every [b]debuff[/b] now has a [b]red border![/b] [b]Super obvious[/b] and [b]super helpful![/b]﻿[/center][/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/GGqFSPR.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/DNNg3fJ.gif[/img][/center][size=3][center]The [b]daily blessings[/b] look way [b]cuter[/b] now. Each one actually [b]feels different[/b] and [b]special[/b], so checking in every morning is [b]more exciting![/b][/center][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/M8kr1G6.png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/0ThtmnH.gif[/img][/center][/b][center]The [b]Dwarf King's powers[/b] finally look [b]as cool as they sound. Crispier [/b]and[b] shinier![/b][/center][/size][center]

[b][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/b][size=1][b]
[size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/b]
[/size][size=4][b]1.[/b][/size] [size=3]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][size=3] and [/size][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Optional) if you haven't yet,[/size]﻿
[b][size=4]2.[/size][/b] [size=3]Download this mod and drop it inside your mods folder
[/size][b][size=4]3.[/size][/b] [size=3]All done and you are ready to go!﻿
[/size][color=#e69138][size=4][b]*[/b][/size][/color] [size=3]To [b]enable[/b] or [b]disable[/b] any icons, run SMAPI once to generate a mod config file and [b]edit it manually [/b](Check images section to see the config examples)
or you can just [b]edit it in game[/b] using the [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size]


[b][color=#ffffff][size=5]CREDITS[/size][/color][size=1][color=#9fc5e8]
[/color][/size][/b][/url][b][size=3]────────────[/size][size=3]✧[/size][size=3]──────[/size][size=3]──────[/size][/b]

[color=#ffd966][size=4]★[/size][/color][size=3] [/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou?gameId=1303][size=3][b]mrtaiyou's[/b][/size][/url]﻿[/b][size=3] work that inspired me to create this mod.[/size]
[size=3]be sure to check out their work as well, [b]I[/b][/size][b][size=3] highly recommend it![/size][/b]
[color=#ffd966][size=4]★[/size][/color][color=#f6b26b] [/color][color=#e69138][size=3][b][url=https://x.com/Rappenem]Rappenem[/url]﻿[/b][/size][/color][color=#ff00ff] [/color][size=3]as i take a lot of inspirations from their works as a reference, [/size]
[size=3]definitely a great pixel artist!


[/size][b][size=5]SPECIAL THANKS[/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=1][color=#9fc5e8]
